text: Select a bicycle equipped with gears tailored to your requirements; these mechanisms allow speed adjustment relative to surface conditions and trip length. Vehicle models vary in gear count, permitting you to select one aligned with your personal tastes and method of operation. After making your selection, prioritize wearing a helmet for head protection against potential falls or collisions. A properly fitted unit remains secure during travel and mitigates impact forces should an accident occur. By utilizing appropriate equipment alongside safety headgear, you enable safe participation in the activity while investigating your surroundings.
